loops.name: shipping-log loop
loops.stop_rule: quiet day posts "quiet day"; it never fabricates activity
loops.note: Derives the shipping log from the public GitHub events API and records its own inference spend. Runs with or without an API key.

loops.name: improvement loop
loops.cadence: weekly · Thu 06:00 UTC (armed; manual until enabled)
loops.stop_rule: proposes at most one change per run, and nothing when nothing is worth doing
loops.note: Reads Elliot's real GitHub activity, Medium writing, and the site's current state, scores its own proposal against a rubric, and only then proposes one employer-facing change as a PR. Its first run's proposal is below, accepted and shipped.

proposals.shipped: Live writing feed added to /built, pulled from the Medium feed at build.
proposals.title: Link new writing: The Loop Was Never the Hard Part
proposals.rationale: Post "The Loop Was Never the Hard Part" (Mon, 13 Jul 2026) isn't linked anywhere on the site. https://medium.com/@elliotJL/the-loop-was-never-the-hard-part-5bdd4352acab
proposals.change: Review and, if employer-relevant, surface this on the site.
